notes.title: Patch Note 1.3 - Language Update: Korean and Simplified Chinese Support Added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195221/1084872d0baa41083a48907beea2c6f75e261447.png[/img]

Greetings, everyone!

This will be our last big patch for now, at least. Most major and minor bugs have been fixed, as well as the game has been tweaked here and there to suit best the players’ feedback.

Firstly, I’d like to remember to [b]please leave a review on Steam[/b]. It helps as boost through Steam’s algorithm in these first weeks after launch ✨

Today we’re bringing some new languages to the game, as well as some minor fixes.

Without further ado, let’s go with it.


[b]Additions[/b]:

● Korean language support (Kim, Tae-yi)

● Chinese (Simplified) language support (Butterfly 和 Torch of Distress + 27ddl)



[b]Changes[/b]:

● Some Heaven Kingdom’s levels have been tweaked, making some sections less frustrating or adjusting some obstacles’ cycles to better support speedrunning.


[b]Fixes[/b]:

● Fixed some collision problems and missing tiles in Boral Peak’s hub

● When unlocking a new biome, its name now properly displays after the unlocking animation.

● Some typos have been tweaked.

● An error regarding getting trapped inside terrain during the final boss fight has been solved.

● Leaderboards are now properly displayed in the first instance of opening a level’s “book menu”.

● The levels’ “book menu” and the hubs’ Atlas have been optimized.

● Camera going off-rails (causing OoB bugs) has presumably been fixed.


[b]Future updates[/b]:

● Steam Cloud still doesn’t work. We don’t really know exactly why, but we’ll try contacting Steam support if we can’t figure out the cause.

● Level selection, exporting ghost racers and in-level ranking view are still things on our minds, although they’re not top priority and we’re currently working on our next project, so we don’t know when they’ll be added


[b]We hope you’ve been enjoying Aureole – Wings of Hope so far. You’re celestial![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195221/388242a50f0abe856b432e9cce9cfce3d8a6930a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.2 - Hellish Hypothermia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195221/1084872d0baa41083a48907beea2c6f75e261447.png[/img]
Hi there, everyone!

It’s now been more than 2 weeks since launch, and the bug-crusher just keeps going!

Thank you so much to everyone that has purchased and played the game, it’s been a blast watching you enjoy the game!

Remember our special -25% discount ends May 29th, so if you know anyone interested in Aureole, now is the best time to get a copy!

[b]Please leave a review on Steam[/b]. It helps as boost through Steam’s algorithm in these first weeks of launch ✨

This version brings some minor additions but a lot of bug fixes, as well as upcoming news on future language support (coming in a few days if everything goes well)!

Without further ado, let’s go with it.



[b]News[/b]:

● The [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Aureole_Wings_of_Hope/levels]speedrun.com[/url] site for Aureole is now up and running, with some players already submitting single level times and others already working on full runs!


[b]Additions[/b]:

● Discord button that redirects to our server added to the title screen

● You can now find a portal at the far left of the Hell Kingdom that lets you watch the credits roll whenever you want

● Already found collectibles now appear translucent / greyish


[b]Changes[/b]:

● All of Hell Kingdom’s and some of Heaven Kingdom’s levels have received several tweaks to make some sections less frustrating and less “trial and error”.

● Several levels’ medal times have been adjusted to be more permissive in the earlier biomes and more challenging on the later ones.

● Collectibles are now saved as found the moment you get them, instead of having to complete the level for it


[b]Fixes[/b]:

● Performance on the final boss stages has improved (presumably).

● The credits roll now properly pop up every time (presumably).

● You can now obtain 100% completion rate on your save file.

● All achievements are obtainable now.

● Hypothermia Summit can now be completed.

● We’ve made some tweaks to the player’s and spikes’ collision to solve several related bugs.

● All dialogs now properly display the speaker’s name and color palette

● Ghost racers now record your best time, instead of the last run, as intended

● The “mini-aureole” bug has been solved

● Heaven Kingdom’s puzzle can now be solved

● Quick restarting a level now displays its transition over the game’s UI

● Chromatic aberration always disappears properly now

● An error causing the player to do a “ground stomp” even when not pressing said action’s button has been solved

● Some typos have been fixed

● Booting up crash is now solved

● Collisions on the final boss stage have been fixed



[b]Future updates[/b]:

● We’ll soon implement Korean and Simplified Chinese support to the game! Stay tuned for that one!

● Steam Cloud still doesn’t work. We don’t really know exactly why, but we’ll try contacting Steam support if we can’t figure out the cause.

● Level selection, exporting ghost racers and in-level ranking view are still things on our minds, although they’re not top priority and we’re currently working on our next project, so we don’t know when they’ll be added (if ever).




Hope this’ll solve every major bug so far haha

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195221/388242a50f0abe856b432e9cce9cfce3d8a6930a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.1 - First Week Survivors
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195221/1084872d0baa41083a48907beea2c6f75e261447.png[/img]
Hi there!

It’s been almost a week since launch and we can’t believe it yet.

Thank you so much to everyone that has purchased and played the game, it’s been a blast watching you enjoy the game, either through streams, reviews or DMs!

I know it’s kind of a cliché, but if you haven’t already, [b]please leave a review on Steam[/b]. It helps as boost through Steam’s algorithm in these first weeks of launch ✨

You can also [b]join our discord[/b] to discuss speedrunning, report bugs or just hang out with us devs directly! ▶ https://discord.gg/6abCBX5wQ4

Now, we’re aware of several bugs and unpolished stuff discovered during last week, some less severe than others. We’ve been working hard this weekend to bring you a patch that should fix almost everything we’ve been reported on, as well as some new additions in response to your feedback.

Without further ado, let’s go with it.

[b]Additions[/b]:
● You can now fast reset a level by holding the “pause” key/button, instead of having to go to the pause menu and hitting restart. This also skips the level intro, making it way faster to retry levels.
● Dialogs can now be skipped over by holding the “confirm” key/button, entering a fast-forward state.
● You can now close the pause menu pressing the “back” button when playing with a controller.
● Some easter-eggs have been added to the Blossoming Forest hub. 👀

[b]Changes[/b]:
● Lostlight Caverns has received a small overhaul. Although the level layout has remained 99% untouched, more decoration has been added to make it look less bland when the crystals are lit. Regarding this, the crystals’ light duration has been slightly increased, while more subtle light sources have been added to make the level traversal less “blind”.
● Subtle layout change in the Blossoming Forest hub, mainly switching Forest Glade and Deep Roots in place.
● Several other subtle layout changes responding to feedback.
● Times have been adjusted for most levels, to better balance the requirements for each medal. Gold medals in the hard levels of each world (the ones unlocked through the puzzles) have been tightened, as some of them were “pretty easy”, considering the harder nature of the levels themselves.
● Crash Site (the tutorial) has received a small change that requires making a double jump to continue, as some players didn’t catch it only through text.
● Crash Site can now also be skipped through the pause menu.
● Dialogs have received a big cut in quantity and length in the first 30 minutes of playtime, including the intro cutscene, the tutorial and the arrival to the Blossoming Forest.
● The “Open Atlas” prompt when near the hubs’ stone now appears much faster.
● Slight changes to the leaderboard view so you can find yourself easier.
● The final boss fight now shows a prompt during the “clash” phase so it’s clearer what to do. The first phase has also been made easier and less frustrating, with less attacks from the boss.
● God Mode now stays for the whole game session when turned on (unless manually turned off, obviously)

[b]Fixes[/b]:
● The scene loading system has been completely reworked, this fixes several errors, such as getting a black screen when retrying a level or having cutscenes repeated. (Presumably)
● The camera system has been changed, now fixing lots of errors regarding the camera following you out of bounds or it getting stuck in place, among others. (Presumably)
● Steam Cloud is now supported (Presumably)
● The Boreal Peak puzzle achievement is working now.
● The final boss fight has received several fixes, such as the level disappearing and having lag/stutter during certain parts.
● Current settings are now always correctly shown in the menu.
● The aspergillum shooting and logo sounds have been lowered. As well as some other sound balancing issues.
● Medal times of 1 minute now show correctly, instead of “00:60.00”
● Removed a repeated hint for the Blossoming Forest puzzle.
● Geodesic Vertex ending flag now shows correctly
● Some typos and dialog errors have been fixed
● Opening the Atlas, unlocking a new biome and selecting it now properly display sound effects.
● Small fixes regarding the leaderboards
● Minecart collisions with Lostlight Caverns’ crystals have been fixed
● Game Speed slider correctly shows current values in settings
● You can no longer go out of bounds in the Blossoming Forest hub 👀

[b]Future updates[/b]:
● We’re not sure if Steam Cloud has been fixed or not. If it’s the latter, please let us know on our Discord server so we can dwell on it.
● Some minor bugs regarding chromatic aberration and other vfx.
● Level selection is something we’ll work on for the next big patch, as it’s a complex system we could not include here.
● We’ll probably make it so you can see how much you’ve climbed through the leaderboards in the results screen, but we’ll see how it’s done.
● The possibility of exporting ghost racers has been brought up, but we’ll need to see how to do that, or if we even end up doing it.
● We’re open for community translations if anyone’s interested (dm us through discord).

Well, this sure has been a lot haha.

[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone that has put their faith in us and our game, especially those “first week survivors” that have been reporting and helping us with everything, such as RL, Shovelclaws, Nene, Milli Cul, Gomolas, Gavilán Pollero, and every streamer or player that has let us know their feedback!

[b]We hope you’ve been enjoying Aureole – Wings of Hope so far. [/b][b]You’re celestial![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195221/388242a50f0abe856b432e9cce9cfce3d8a6930a.png[/img]
